description: Flood — Awareness — Extents is a dataset listed in Brisbane City Council open data portal (data.brisbane.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. This dataset, created in June 2013, represents the areas at a risk of flooding from one or more sources: River, Creek, Overland Flow and Storm tide inside the Brisbane City Council local government area. This layer contributes to the overall Flood Awareness Mapping for Brisbane City Council. Coverage: Brisbane, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Brisbane City Council. Its tags are arcgis, environment, creek flood, fam, fio. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json, geojson. The portal shows 2025-10-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
